title: Star War Inspired Game, made in just 4 hours
author: Yanxi_Tracy
selftext:
I started with “let me fix this one animation” and suddenly I’m knee-deep in:

* new combat tweaks
* slightly cursed boss AI
* and a map that only exists because I wanted to test a lighting shader lol

Anyway, the game is called **SITH WARRIOR** — you play as a fallen Jedi clawing their way up through the Sith ranks. Still super early, still rough, but vibe-coding is powerful dark magic apparently.

If you want to poke at the build (no pressure):  
[https://4trr2j7w.gambo.games/](https://4trr2j7w.gambo.games/)

Back to pretending I’m productive.

comments.author: CulturalFig1237
comments.body: Accessed your game. Cool actually!! I like how this feels, I'm just like playing video game. Really liked it. Will you be able to share it to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) so other users can provide valuable feedback too?

replies.author: Yanxi_Tracy
replies.body: Sure, thank you! I’m really glad you liked my game concepts and ideas. I’d love to share them with vibecodinglist.com. By the way, is it okay if I include a link for people who are interested in vibe-coding games using Gambo? Or do you have a specific section dedicated to game vibe-coding?

replies.author: CulturalFig1237
replies.body: [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) is a one-stop shop. You can just share any of your project there! Hope to see this soon there!

comments.author: IncorrectAddress
comments.body: May the ~~Force~~ AI be with you !

comments.author: agarlington
comments.body: i seenyou used Gambo aI? that one is new for me. i vibe code my games in Makkko AI or Rosebud. they are pretty good tools too, will have to check out Gambo

replies.author: Yanxi_Tracy
replies.body:
Hi! Yes, I’ve tried Claude before, but it didn’t really match my game-creation workflow. I chose Gambo because:

1. It’s super easy to upload the game assets I want (and it can also generate assets, music, and VFX on its own), which gives me a lot of room for adjustment and refinement.
2. The initial game demos it produces are always stunning — that’s why I’ve continued using it.

For example, this Star-Wars-inspired Sith Warrior game only took me about 4 hours to make.

replies.author: agarlington
replies.body: thanks for bringing it to my attention!
